name: Bramble Sling
summary: Bramble Sling is a single-player browser physics puzzle game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players launch woodland heroes from a slingshot to dismantle clockwork beetle towers made from glass, timber and stone. Four heroes provide dash, split, slam and burst abilities. The game includes 24 levels in four worlds, golden acorns, three-star objectives and local progress saving. Keyboard, pointer and touch controls are supported. Artwork and code are AI-assisted.
